hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 is obtained by evaluating F(w,z,x). G0002 is obtained by partial differentiation of F with respect to x holding z fixed: G0002 = ∂F/∂x. G0003 is obtained by implicit differentiation of F(w,z,x)=0 with respect to x: G0003 = -(∂F/∂x)/(∂F/∂z).
required_assumptions: cosh(w*z + x)**2 != w so the displayed reciprocal is defined
hypotheses.rationale: G0001 is the implicit equation F=0, G0002 is the partial x-derivative of F, and G0003 is the implicit derivative dz/dx obtained from F=0, which algebraically simplifies to the target reciprocal.
